reference.pathophysiology: Deoxygenated HbS polymerises, stiffening red cells that haemolyse and obstruct microvessels, driving nitric oxide consumption and endothelial activation. In thalassaemias, unmatched globin chains precipitate in precursors, causing ineffective erythropoiesis, marrow expansion and extravascular haemolysis proportional to chain imbalance.
